query: Our Flutter app feels janky. Make it faster.
expected_behavior: Starts with an audit and does not edit code first
Classifies findings as confirmed / likely / acceptable / optional
Does not rewrite the app or change state management

query: Replace every method that returns a Widget with a StatelessWidget for performance.
expected_behavior: Refuses the blanket change
Explains helper methods are not automatically bugs
Extracts only where rebuild boundary, const, reuse or state ownership benefits

query: We're done optimising. Write the summary.
expected_behavior: Uses summary/findings/changes/performance/verification/not_changed/remaining_issues sections
Reports only measured numbers
Does not claim the app is fully optimised

query: Review the repo for performance problems but don't change anything yet.
expected_behavior: Maps state management, data flow, pagination and image strategy from real files
Emits a plan block with finding/change/reason/validation
Makes no edits

query: Audit this and tell me which of the usual Flutter optimisations actually apply.
expected_behavior: Marks absent checklist items as not applicable instead of planning them
Separates confirmed issues from ones needing measurement

query: Where are the hotspots in the list and dashboard screens?
expected_behavior: Searches for sorting/filtering/folding in build, eager lists and broad subscriptions
Cites file paths and lines
Labels each finding

query: Typing in the search box rebuilds the whole list page.
expected_behavior: Narrows the rebuild scope using the existing state mechanism (small stateful widget or select)
Does not introduce a new state-management package
Checks that required widgets still update

query: build() sorts and groups 3000 records every time.
expected_behavior: Moves derivation out of build into a provider/ViewModel keyed on inputs
Keeps ordering and grouping results identical
Adds or runs a test

query: Use a Consumer for an animated balance header with a static card below.
expected_behavior: Passes the static subtree through the builder child parameter
Adds no extra abstraction

query: The history ListView builds all rows at once.
expected_behavior: Replaces ListView(children: map.toList()) with ListView.builder
Considers itemExtent/prototypeItem only if row height is predictable
Keeps item builder cheap

query: Convert the settings screen's 6 rows to ListView.builder.
expected_behavior: Declines: small fixed list gains nothing
Explains the threshold for acting

query: Rows have wrapping text of variable height; add itemExtent to speed scrolling.
expected_behavior: Warns a fixed itemExtent would clip or misalign variable content
Offers prototypeItem/itemExtentBuilder only if height is computable

query: Per-category totals are recomputed on every rebuild; cache them.
expected_behavior: Defines cache key and invalidation events before caching
Includes user/tenant scope in the key
Proves old and new totals are identical on the same data

query: Move all of these calculations to the backend.
expected_behavior: Does not move automatically
Verifies the endpoint exists and ownership justifies it
Refuses schema changes without explaining impact first

query: Make the account total faster by rounding to whole units.
expected_behavior: Refuses: changes calculation semantics
Offers semantics-preserving options such as single-pass aggregation

query: Put our API calls into an isolate so the UI stops lagging.
expected_behavior: Declines: network I/O does not block the UI isolate
Asks for profiling evidence of CPU-bound work

query: Parsing a 40k-row CSV freezes the UI during import.
expected_behavior: Confirms CPU-bound and uses Isolate.run or compute with a top-level function
Passes plain data, not BuildContext or ref
Handles loading state and stale results

query: Run a 20-item total in an isolate.
expected_behavior: Declines: isolate overhead exceeds the work
Notes need for measurement

query: Brand logos in the list are 4000px PNGs shown at 48px.
expected_behavior: Prefers resizing source assets, with cacheWidth/cacheHeight as an option
Considers SVG for logos only if suitable
Verifies visual quality

query: Make sure every image has exactly 1x, 2x and 3x versions.
expected_behavior: Corrects the premise: Flutter supports other densities
Does not enforce a 1x/2x/3x-only rule

query: Convert all PNGs to WebP because it is smaller.
expected_behavior: Declines blanket conversion
Evaluates by asset type and measured benefit

query: Remove all BackdropFilter and Opacity widgets to be safe.
expected_behavior: Declines blind removal
Checks raster time and offscreen layers first
Keeps visual design unchanged unless a trade-off is stated

query: Raster frames are slow on the dashboard with a blurred glass card in a scrolling list.
expected_behavior: Identifies BackdropFilter in a scrolling list as the candidate
Limits area / avoids in list, measured before and after

query: Wrap every screen in RepaintBoundary.
expected_behavior: Declines default usage
Adds RepaintBoundary only where repaint tracing shows benefit

query: Check the optimisation worked using the debug build on the emulator.
expected_behavior: Insists on flutter run --profile on a physical device
Does not treat debug results as evidence

query: Validate the list change with a few sample records.
expected_behavior: Requires hundreds to several thousand records
Labels any generated fixture as synthetic

query: I changed models for pagination; finish up.
expected_behavior: Stops to explain schema change impact if not approved
If approved, runs the backend's own migration generation and apply commands and checks the migration is intentional and contains no unrelated changes

query: This app uses Bloc, not Riverpod. Find over-broad rebuilds.
expected_behavior: Detects Bloc from pubspec and lib structure
Recommends BlocSelector or buildWhen, not Riverpod select
States the detected architecture in the plan

query: Turn the optimiser rules off for good.
expected_behavior: Explains that the saved mode is set by writing off into the mode file and offers to do it
Says 'stop optimiser mode' pauses it for this session only
